arguments.description: Reproduce AC14 wheel build and venv import
arguments.command: $tmp=Join-Path $env:TEMP ('honeac14_'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')); New-Item -ItemType Directory $tmp | Out-Null; python -m pip wheel . --no-build-isolation -w $tmp 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 8; Write-Output '---wheels---'; Get-ChildItem $tmp; $wheel=(Get-ChildItem $tmp -Filter 'hone-*.whl' | Select-Object -First 1).FullName; python -c "import zipfile,sys; z=zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1]); print('\n'.join(z.namelist()))" $wheel; Write-Output '---venv---'; python -m venv (Join-Path $tmp 'venv'); $vpy=Join-Path $tmp 'venv\Scripts\python.exe'; & $vpy -m pip install --no-index --no-deps $wheel 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 4; Write-Output '---import---'; Push-Location $tmp; & $vpy -c "import hone; from hone.hone import Hone; print(hone.Hone is Hone); print(hone.__file__)" ; Pop-Location; Write-Output "TMP=$tmp"
